scope: Read current official Apple API descriptions only; not an archived macOS14 implementation trace or proof of framework arbitration.

interpretation.claim: Writing the identity binding requests that item, and the anchor influences identity choice and alignment; no documented numeric margin/clip formula establishes the observed 14.5pt.

Documentation names gesture-end and scroll-view-size changes as the two main invocation cases. This is not an exhaustive prohibition on other contexts, so it cannot prove native14 never arbitrates programmatic requests.
An explicit anchor aligns corresponding points of the identified view and its scroll view. Actual native view geometry and offset were not exported by the previous collector.

effect_on_next_action: Keep source eligibility separate from actual execution; collect bounded request/legacy writer/native terminal state before changing alignment, margins or scheduling.
